relationships.subject: chronic pain
relationships.evidence_quote: the pain versus no pain groups showing significantly higher alcohol cue‐elicited alcohol craving (p = 0.03; Figure 2)

relationships.subject: anterior insular cortex
relationships.evidence_quote: a more blunted response in these areas was associated with greater alcohol cue‐induced craving among individuals with pain

key_findings: Individuals with pain showed higher alcohol cue-elicited craving and altered dACC, amygdala, AIC and OFC cue reactivity.
Blunted right AIC and OFC responses correlated with greater alcohol cue-induced craving in pain.
